provenance.definition: Chart as curated in tools/surfdb/charts.py, verified numerically against the curvature condition the record claims (measured over the chart by the validator and the charts self-test).
sources: T. Kuen, 'Ueber Flachen von constantem Krummungsmass', Sitzungsber. Bayer. Akad. Wiss. (1884).

caveats: A Backlund transform of the pseudosphere; a staple of the Gottingen plaster-model collection.

description.summary: Kuen Surface is a surface of constant negative Gaussian curvature, given by a parametrisation, self-intersecting.

formulas.label: x(u, v)
formulas.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>u</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mi>u</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>u</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mrow><msup><mi>u</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>⁢</mo><msup><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{2 \left(\cos\left(u\right) + u \sin\left(u\right)\right) \sin\left(v\right)}{1 + u^{2} \sin\left(v\right)^{2}}</annotation></semantics></math>

formulas.label: y(u, v)
formulas.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>u</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><mi>u</mi><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>u</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo>⁢</mo><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mrow><msup><mi>u</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>⁢</mo><msup><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{2 \left(\sin\left(u\right) - u \cos\left(u\right)\right) \sin\left(v\right)}{1 + u^{2} \sin\left(v\right)^{2}}</annotation></semantics></math>
